faq.q: What is One-Eyed Willie's in GTA 6?
faq.a: One-Eyed Willie's is an off-road vehicle modification shop located in Lake Leonida. Rockstar says it specializes in modifications and hand-painted custom art for off-road vehicles.

faq.q: How is One-Eyed Willie's different from Rideout Customs?
faq.a: Rideout Customs focuses on street and lowrider style builds, while One-Eyed Willie's specializes in off-road vehicles with hand-painted custom art. The record lists them as separate, distinct mod shops.

faq.q: Does One-Eyed Willie's reference The Goonies?
faq.a: Fans widely believe the name references the pirate character One-Eyed Willy from the 1985 film The Goonies, but Rockstar has not confirmed this connection in any official material.

faq.q: Where is One-Eyed Willie's located in GTA 6?
faq.a: It is located in Lake Leonida. This places it away from the Vice City storefronts like Stock 305 and Electric Fang Tattoo, which sit in the Stockyard neighborhood.

faq.q: Is One-Eyed Willie's available to Standard Edition owners?
faq.a: No. It is confirmed as Ultimate Edition exclusive content, so Standard Edition owners cannot access the shop.
